result.title: Cache2LoRA: Understanding and Improving Context Internalization
result.summary: Context-to-LoRA methods encode documents as low-rank parameter updates, allowing language models to answer without retaining the source text in their decoding context. How reliably do these updates preserve facts and support their use under different instructions? Controlled diagnosis of existing context-to-LoRA methods separates fact discrimination, target retention, and response adaptation. Competing sources influence answers, while target-only construction and memory-state optimization improve recovery at fixed update size. Recovering facts also does not ensure that answers follow response instructions. We introduce Cache2LoRA, which uses each query to aggregate evidence from a reusable frozen document cache before generating LoRA updates. Trainable encoding operates only on the query and memory-token suffix, and multi-style supervision teaches both evidence preservation and answer expression. Across 17 tasks, Cache2LoRA improves on existing context-to-LoRA methods and achieves macro F1 of 0.663, approaching full-context in-context learning at 0.671. For 32K documents and 256-token outputs at batch size 16, its decoding throughput is 5.9$\times$ that of full-context ICL. At matched memory size, generated LoRA preserves answer accuracy more reliably than the learned-KV variant under long, diverse intervening text and combines more effectively with retained document KV, yielding higher hybrid F1 and EM.

AI.brief_summary: 论文受控诊断 context-to-LoRA 在事实区分、目标保持与回复适配上的失效，并提出 Cache2LoRA：用查询从可复用的冻结文档缓存中聚合证据再生成 LoRA 更新，可训练编码仅作用于查询与 memory token 后缀，并以多风格监督同时教证据保持与答案表达，在 17 个任务上接近全上下文 ICL。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽为纯文本、非视觉工作，但其查询条件化的缓存证据聚合、memory token 后缀上的训练监督、生成式 LoRA 与保留文档 KV 的混合，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、latent 状态更新与「答案是否真正使用 latent 内容」的贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索。
